title: 第19章 萧海的忧虑第20章 落日军团成立
lines: 萧羽跟随那名弟子来到了，萧海的书房，发现萧海正站在书房的中间。
“家主，羽少爷已经带来了."说完这位弟子便是轻轻关上房门走了出去。
萧羽赶紧上前一步，拱手道：“萧羽拜见家主。”
萧海摆摆手说到：“这里只有你我两个人，叫我二伯就好了。”
见萧羽并没有回应，萧海知道因为上次的事情，萧羽一时半会还是很难原谅他的。
当然萧海也并没有在之前的事情上继续纠结，而直接向萧羽问道：“这次，吴，关，刘三家彻底联手了，已经在黑石矿脉多次对我萧家子弟出手，萧虎也因此受了重伤，你大哥萧龙也已经赶到矿山上与另外三大家族的年轻一代进行对抗，可是他一人也是孤掌难鸣！
毕竟现在只是年轻一代弟子的对峙，老一辈的高阶武者还保持着潜在的默契都没有出手，所以我希望你可以去帮帮萧龙！萧家年轻一代也只有你和你大哥两人有资格去面对另外三大家族的天骄们了。”
萧海眼睛灼灼的看着萧羽，萧羽并没有立刻回复。
这样一来萧海内心就有点焦急了！毕竟萧龙一个人的压力着实是有点大了。按照上次萧羽击杀张执事的表现，萧羽的真实战力绝对不会比灵武境三重的萧龙弱！
在尴尬的沉寂中，萧海也是惊讶的发现，萧羽上次击败张执事的时候好像并没有任何的灵力波动，只是靠的肉身力量和刀意，而这次，萧羽在一个月左右的时间里，达到了聚气境九重！
还真是个令人惊讶的小子，可是在目前萧家年轻一辈处于弱势的情况下，萧羽越强对萧家来说越是一件好事！
在萧海焦急的等待中，萧羽则是在考虑另一件事情，就是如何仍够让萧海承认，那20几人属于萧家！突然萧羽眼睛一亮，拿定了主意。向萧海道：“家主，我此次在落日山脉历练结识几位与我年龄相仿的朋友."
"哦。”萧海有些心不在焉。
“嗯，就是他们都属于自由冒险者。”
“哦。”我想听的不是这个啊，萧海心道。
“他们的年龄与我相仿，但是实力都在灵武境以上，地武境以下！”萧羽继续道。
和你年龄相仿，灵武境以上的实力，那岂不是个个都跟萧龙差不多了？这种天才，你能结识一个就算不错了，还几个？可是这跟我们萧家的危机有什么关系，你总不会说是，他们想要加入萧家，为萧家出战吧？
萧海继续心不在焉的”哦“了一声。
“我想要家主给他们一个身份，让他们和我一起前往矿脉！”萧羽有些忐忑的道，毕竟人数太多了，加上弓紫嫣，蛮儿，和黑子一共有27人了。
而且赤火佣兵团的那24人可谓个个都是天才，毕竟作为天阳帝国的第一大佣兵团，怎么会没有天才弟子，更何况这24人是整个佣兵团覆灭也要保护的火种，怎么可能是庸才？
“哦，他们要加入我萧家参战。嗯？你说什么？”萧海突然拉着萧羽道。
这一举动倒是吓了萧羽一跳，该不会是家主不愿意吧？萧羽倒是有些不好意思了。
“可是真的愿意加入我萧家？”萧海再次问道。
“是的，只是不知道，家族令牌可否发放给他们？”萧羽自己都觉得不好意思了。
“哈哈。”萧海突然大笑道：“好，我准了，我写个手谕给你，你拿着即刻帮他们办理我萧家子弟身份，同时告诉负责身份登记考校的李执事，就说是我说的，不用考评直接将你的朋友记入萧家之册，发放身份令牌！不，我直接写道手谕，你办理完成之后迅速赶往矿脉，与你大哥会和！”
这么简单？萧羽还有些发愣，萧羽准备的一些说辞还都没有说出来。
“愣着干什么？快去！”萧还将手谕丢给萧羽催促道。
萧羽拿着手谕，立刻向他租赁的那个院子跑去，在付了6000下品灵石之后就带着一群人回到了萧家府上，这个让守门的弟子吓得不轻，毕竟这么多的灵武境同时到来，还都那么年轻，不知道的还以为找茬来的，要不是有拿着手谕的萧羽在，守门弟子还真就不敢让他们进去！
然后萧羽拿着手谕直接来找李执事，李执事也是一惊，可是反复看了几遍确实是家主的手谕，也就没有多问，一一将他们的名字登记并记入在每人的令牌当中。

content_en:
Xiao Yu followed the disciple to Xiao Hai's study and found Xiao Hai standing in the middle of the study.
"Master, Master Yu has already brought you here." After saying this, the disciple gently closed the door and walked out.
Xiao Yu quickly stepped forward, cupped his hands and said, "Xiao Yu pays homage to the master of the family."
Xiao Hai waved his hand and said: "There are only two of you and me here, just call me second uncle."
Seeing that Xiao Yu didn't respond, Xiao Hai knew that it would be difficult for Xiao Yu to forgive him for a while because of what happened last time.
Of course, Xiao Hai did not continue to dwell on the previous matter, but directly asked Xiao Yu: "This time, the three families of Wu, Guan, and Liu have completely joined forces. They have attacked the Xiao family's children many times in the Black Stone Mine. Xiao Hu has also been seriously injured. Your eldest brother Xiao Long has also rushed to the mine to fight against the younger generations of the other three major families, but he can't stand alone!"
After all, it is just a confrontation between the younger generation of disciples. The older generation of high-level warriors still maintain a potential tacit understanding and have not taken action, so I hope you can help Xiao Long! Of the younger generation of the Xiao family, only you and your eldest brother are qualified to face the geniuses of the other three major families. "
Xiao Hai looked at Xiao Yu with burning eyes, but Xiao Yu did not reply immediately.
This made Xiao Hai feel a little anxious! After all, Xiao Long's pressure on his own was really a bit high. According to Xiao Yu's performance in killing Deacon Zhang last time, Xiao Yu's true combat power will definitely not be weaker than Xiao Long, who is at the third level of the spiritual martial arts realm!
In the awkward silence, Xiao Hai was also surprised to find that Xiao Yu didn't seem to have any spiritual power fluctuations when he defeated Deacon Zhang last time. He only relied on physical strength and sword intention. But this time, Xiao Yu reached the ninth level of Qi Gathering Realm in about a month!
He is really an amazing boy, but in the current situation where the younger generation of the Xiao family is in a weak position, the stronger Xiao Yu is, the better it is for the Xiao family!
While Xiao Hai was waiting anxiously, Xiao Yu was thinking about another thing, which was how to get Xiao Hai to admit that those 20 people belonged to the Xiao family! Suddenly Xiao Yu's eyes lit up and he made up his mind. Xiang Xiao Hai said: "Master, I have made a few friends around my age during this experience in the Sunset Mountains."
"Oh." Xiao Hai was a little absent-minded.
"Well, they are all free adventurers."
"Oh." That's not what I want to hear, Xiao Hai thought.
"They are similar in age to me, but their strength is above the Spiritual Martial Realm and below the Earthly Martial Realm!" Xiao Yu continued.
If you are about the same age as you and have a strength above the Spiritual Martial Realm, wouldn't it mean that everyone is almost the same as Xiao Long? If you can get to know one of these geniuses, it’s considered good, but how many more? But what does this have to do with the crisis of our Xiao family? You will never say that they want to join the Xiao family and fight for the Xiao family, right?
Xiao Hai continued to say "Oh" absentmindedly.
"I want the head of the family to give them an identity and let them go to the mines with me!" Xiao Yu said with some anxiety. After all, there were too many people. With Gong Ziyan, Man'er, and Heizi, there were 27 people in total.
Moreover, the 24 people in the Red Fire Mercenary Group are all geniuses. After all, as the largest mercenary group in the Tianyang Empire, how could there be no talented disciples? What's more, these 24 people are the fire that must be protected even if the entire mercenary group is destroyed. How can they be mediocre?
"Oh, they want to join my Xiao family in the war. Huh? What did you say?" Xiao Hai suddenly pulled Xiao Yu and said.
This move shocked Xiao Yu. Could it be that the head of the family was unwilling? Xiao Yu felt a little embarrassed.
"But are you really willing to join my Xiao family?" Xiao Hai asked again.
"Yes, I just don't know if the family token can be issued to them?" Xiao Yu himself felt embarrassed.
"Haha." Xiao Hai suddenly laughed and said: "Okay, I'm sure. I'll write you a handwriting. You can take it and immediately help them apply for the identity of my Xiao family's children. At the same time, tell Deacon Li, who is in charge of the identity registration and examination, just say it's me and record your friends directly into the Xiao family's book without assessment and issue identity tokens! No, I will directly write the handwriting. After you complete the application, rush to the mine veins to meet your eldest brother!"
So simple? Xiao Yu was still in a daze, and some of the words Xiao Yu had prepared had not been spoken yet.
"What are you doing standing there in a daze? Go quickly!" Xiao Huan threw the oracle to Xiao Yu and urged.
Xiao Yu took the oracle and immediately ran to the courtyard he rented. After paying 6,000 low-grade spiritual stones, he led a group of people back to the Xiao family's house. This frightened the disciples guarding the gate. After all, so many spiritual martial realms arrived at the same time, and they were all so young. Those who didn't know it thought they were looking for trouble. If Xiao Yu hadn't been there with the oracle, the disciples guarding the gate would not have dared to let them in!
Then Xiao Yu came directly to Deacon Li with the oracle. Deacon Li was also surprised, but after reading it several times that it was indeed the owner's handwriting, he didn't ask any more questions and registered their names one by one and recorded them in each person's token.
